from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    seen0=set(); outside=set()
    enclosed=[]
    # connected components of zeros
    comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        if grid[r][c]==0 and (r,c) not in seen0:
          q=[(r,c)]; seen0.add((r,c)); comp=[]; edge=False
          for x,y in q:
            comp.append((x,y)); edge |= x==0 or y==0 or x==h-1 or y==w-1
            for nx,ny in ((x-1,y),(x+1,y),(x,y-1),(x,y+1)):
              if 0<=nx<h and 0<=ny<w and grid[nx][ny]==0 and (nx,ny) not in seen0:
                seen0.add((nx,ny)); q.append((nx,ny))
          comps.append((comp,edge))
    active_ones=set()
    for comp,edge in comps:
      if not edge:
        for r,c in comp:
          for nr,nc in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
            if 0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w and grid[nr][nc]==1:
              out[r][c]=3
              active_ones.add((nr,nc))
    # extend active status over entire 4-connected one components
    seen1=set()
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        if grid[r][c]==1 and (r,c) not in seen1:
          q=[(r,c)]; seen1.add((r,c)); comp=[]
          for x,y in q:
            comp.append((x,y))
            for nx,ny in ((x-1,y),(x+1,y),(x,y-1),(x,y+1)):
              if 0<=nx<h and 0<=ny<w and grid[nx][ny]==1 and (nx,ny) not in seen1:
                seen1.add((nx,ny)); q.append((nx,ny))
          if any(p in active_ones for p in comp):
            for x,y in comp:
              for nx,ny in ((x-1,y),(x+1,y),(x,y-1),(x,y+1)):
                if 0<=nx<h and 0<=ny<w and grid[nx][ny]==0 and out[nx][ny]==0:
                  # Exterior side only; the inside boundary is colored 3 above.
                  # This also prevents overwriting already marked interior ring.
                  if any((nx,ny) in zcomp and edge for zcomp,edge in comps):
                    out[nx][ny]=2
    return out
